# Crasoft

> Crasoft is a US software company founded in 2020. We design and build our own software products, plus custom web and mobile apps for businesses and founders.

Crasoft (crasoftinc.com) is a software company in the United States. It does two things: it makes and runs its own software products, and it builds custom software for other companies and founders, from the first idea to launch and support after launch.

## Key facts

- Name: Crasoft
- Type: Software company
- Founded: 2020
- Country: United States
- Website: https://crasoftinc.com
- Email: info@crasoftinc.com
- Slogan: Crafted software.

## Services

- Turn your idea into a product: for founders and startups with an idea. We design, build and launch it with you.
- Software for your business: websites, mobile apps and tools made to fit the way your company works.
- Support after launch: we keep improving, fixing and growing your software after it goes live.

## Products built by Crasoft

- [TFONE TMS](https://www.thetfone.com): one place to manage loads, dispatch, drivers, trucks, billing and documents.
- [TFONE Driver App](https://www.thetfone.com): drivers see loads, update status and send documents from the road.
- TFONE Navigation: plans routes based on a truck's height and size.
- TFSign: sign documents online, without printing or scanning.
- Relay TMS Sync: a Chrome extension that syncs loads from Relay into TFONE TMS.
